answer: A dawn of per-task receipts records who did what, and the sonnet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. By the orchard of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
